SELECT
    TO_CHAR(j."DST_SID") || '-' || TO_CHAR(j."JN_REV_NUM") AS jn_del_st_enota_pk,
    j."DST_SID" AS dst_sid,
    j."ID_MODEL" AS id_model,
    j."ID_MODEL_VER" AS id_model_ver,
    j."RAVEN" AS raven,
    j."VPLIV" AS vpliv,
    j."VREDNOST" AS vrednost,
    j."CONA_IME" AS cona_ime,
    CAST(TRIM(j."JN_STATUS") AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS jn_status,
    j."FAKTOR_PO" AS faktor_po,
    j."POSPLOSENA_VREDNOST" AS posplosena_vrednost,
    FROM_TZ(CAST(rf.CREATED AS TIMESTAMP), 'Europe/Ljubljana') AS valid_from,
    FROM_TZ(CAST(rt.CREATED AS TIMESTAMP), 'Europe/Ljubljana') AS valid_to,
    FROM_TZ(CAST(COALESCE(rt.CREATED, rf.CREATED) AS TIMESTAMP), 'Europe/Ljubljana') AS date_change,
    FROM_TZ(CAST(COALESCE(RT.CREATED, RF.CREATED) AS TIMESTAMP), 'Europe/Ljubljana') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS date_change_utc
FROM EV.JN_DEL_STAVBE_ENOTA j
JOIN EV.REVISION rf ON j."JN_REV_NUM" = rf.REV_NUM
LEFT JOIN EV.REVISION rt ON j."JN_REV_NUM_TO" = rt.REV_NUM
WHERE j."JN_STATUS" <> 'X'
  AND rf.CREATED >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'

    from_tz(cast(COALESCE(RT.CREATED, RF.CREATED) as TIMESTAMP), 'Europe/Ljubljana')                 date_change,

    CAST(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(m.XML_ORIGINALNI, 500, 1),
        'verzija:[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)', 1, 1, 'i', 1
    )) AS INTEGER) AS verzija_gv_originalna,
    CAST(TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(
        DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(m.XML, 500, 1),
        'verzija:[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)', 1, 1, 'i', 1
    )) AS INTEGER) AS verzija_gv_izvajalna,
    m.ID_GRUPA AS id_grupa,
    FROM_TZ(CAST(m.DATUM_OD AS TIMESTAMP), 'Europe/Ljubljana') AS datum_od,
    FROM_TZ(CAST(m.DATUM_DO AS TIMESTAMP), 'Europe/Ljubljana') AS datum_do,
    FROM_TZ(CAST(g.DATUM_TRGA AS TIMESTAMP), 'Europe/Ljubljana') AS datum_trga

LEFT JOIN EV.MODELI_GRUPA g ON g.ID_GRUPA = m.ID_GRUPA

CASE
        WHEN SDO_UTIL.TO_WKTGEOMETRY(GEOM) LIKE 'MULTIPOLYGON%' THEN SDO_UTIL.TO_WKTGEOMETRY(GEOM)
        WHEN SDO_UTIL.TO_WKTGEOMETRY(GEOM) LIKE 'POLYGON%' THEN
            SDO_UTIL.TO_WKTGEOMETRY(SDO_GEOMETRY(
                2007,
                TREAT(geom AS MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_SRID,

       select 171, 'vrste_postopkov_rpe', vrsta_postopka_rpe_id, cast(sifra as integer), naziv_sl, null, opis_sl
       from sif.vrste_postopkov_rpe

       union all

       select 172,
              'vrste_podrobne_dejanske_rabe',
              vrsta_podrobne_dejanske_rabe_id,
              cast(sifra as integer),
              naziv_sl,
              null,
              opis_sl
       from sif.vrste_podrobne_dejanske_rabe

       union all

       select 173, 'gji', gji_id, cast(sifra as integer), naziv_sl, null, opis_sl
       from sif.gji

       union all

       select 174, 'gji_aktivnosti_vodov', gji_aktivnost_voda_id, cast(sifra as integer), naziv_sl, null, opis_sl
       from sif.gji_aktivnosti_vodov

       union all

       select 175, 'gji_atr1', gji_atr1_id, cast(sifra as integer), naziv_sl, null, opis_sl
       from sif.gji_atr1

       union all

       select 176, 'gji_atr2', gji_atr2_id, cast(sifra as integer), naziv_sl, null, opis_sl
       from sif.gji_atr2

       union all

       select 177, 'gji_atr3', gji_atr3_id, cast(sifra as integer), naziv_sl, null, opis_sl
       from sif.gji_atr3

       union all

       select 178, 'gji_atr4', gji_atr4_id, cast(sifra as integer), naziv_sl, null, opis_sl
       from sif.gji_atr4

       union all

       select 187, 'gji_tematike', gji_tematika_id, cast(sifra as integer), naziv_sl, null, opis_sl
       from sif.gji_tematike

       union all

       select 188, 'gji_viri', gji_vir_id, cast(sifra as integer), naziv_sl, null, opis_sl
       from sif.gji_viri

       union all

       select 194, 'podrobne_namenske_rabe', podrobna_namenska_raba_id, cast(sifra as integer), naziv_sl, null, opis_sl
       from sif.podrobne_namenske_rabe

       union all

       select 199, 'drzave', drzava_id, drzava_id, naziv_sl, sifra, null
       from sif.drzave

       union all

       select 214, 'pod_nam_rabe', pod_nam_raba_id, cast(sifra as integer), naziv_sl, null, opis_sl
       from sif.pod_nam_rabe

       union all

       select 267, 'vrste_draba', vrsta_draba_id, cast(sifra as integer), naziv_sl, null, opis_sl
       from sif.vrste_draba ) s
         join ( select metadata_sifrant_id, lower(trim(sifrant)) as sifrant
                from sif.metadata_sifranti
                where vidnost_distribucija = 1
                  and metadata_sifrant_id in
                      (13, 19, 20, 22, 23, 24, 25, 26, 27, 28, 29, 31, 35, 37, 42, 53, 77, 78, 87, 95, 96, 113, 114,
                       171, 172, 173, 174, 175, 176, 177, 178, 187, 188, 194, 199, 214, 267) ) m
              on m.metadata_sifrant_id = s.sifrant_id and m.sifrant = s.sifrant
order by s.sifrant_id, s.sifra

select STAVBA_H_ID,
       STAVBA_ID,
       POSTOPEK_ID_OD,
       POSTOPEK_ID_DO,
       from_tz(cast(DATUM_OD as TIMESTAMP), 'Europe/Ljubljana')  DATUM_OD,
       from_tz(cast(DATUM_DO as TIMESTAMP), 'Europe/Ljubljana')  DATUM_DO,
       from_tz(cast(DATUM_SYS as TIMESTAMP), 'Europe/Ljubljana') DATUM_SYS,
       FROM_TZ(CAST(DATUM_SYS AS TIMESTAMP), 'Europe/Ljubljana') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS datum_sys_utc,
       EID,
       case when OBRIS_GEOM is null then null
           -- Če je že MULTIPOLYGON, ohrani enako
            when SDO_UTIL.TO_WKTGEOMETRY(OBRIS_GEOM) like 'MULTIPOLYGON%' then SDO_UTIL.TO_WKTGEOMETRY(OBRIS_GEOM)
           -- Če je POLYGON in vsebuje SDO_ORDINATES, pretvori v MULTIPOLYGON
            when SDO_UTIL.TO_WKTGEOMETRY(OBRIS_GEOM) like 'POLYGON%' then SDO_UTIL.TO_WKTGEOMETRY(SDO_GEOMETRY(
                    2007, -- GTYPE za MULTIPOLYGON
                    treat(OBRIS_GEOM as MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_SRID, -- Retain the original SRID
                    null, treat(OBRIS_GEOM as MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_ELEM_INFO, -- Use existing element info
                    treat(OBRIS_GEOM as MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_ORDINATES -- Use existing ordinates
                                                                                                  ))
            else null end as                                     GEOM
from nep.STAVBE_H

select STAVBA_PARCELA_H_ID,
       STAVBA_PARCELA_ID,
       POVRSINA,
       PARCELA_ID,
       STAVBA_ID,
       STEVILKA_STAVBE,
       E_CEN,
       N_CEN,
       case when mod(treat(GEOM as MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_GTYPE, 1000) != 1 then SDO_UTIL.TO_WKTGEOMETRY(GEOM)
            when mod(treat(GEOM as MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_GTYPE, 1000) = 1 then SDO_UTIL.TO_WKTGEOMETRY(SDO_GEOMETRY(
                    2003, null, null, SDO_ELEM_INFO_ARRAY(1, 1003, 1),
                    SDO_ORDINATE_ARRAY(treat(geom as MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_POINT.X - 0.05,
                                       treat(geom as MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_POINT.Y - 0.05,
                                       treat(geom as MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_POINT.X - 0.05,
                                       treat(geom as MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_POINT.Y + 0.05,
                                       treat(geom as MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_POINT.X + 0.05,
                                       treat(geom as MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_POINT.Y + 0.05,
                                       treat(geom as MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_POINT.X + 0.05,
                                       treat(geom as MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_POINT.Y - 0.05,
                                       treat(geom as MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_POINT.X - 0.05,
                                       treat(geom as MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY).SDO_POINT.Y - 0.05))) end as GEOM,
       POVRSINA_GEOM,
       VRSTA_POVEZAVE_ID,
       POSTOPEK_ID_OD,
       POSTOPEK_ID_DO,
       from_tz(cast(DATUM_OD as TIMESTAMP), 'Europe/Ljubljana')                                       DATUM_OD,

       EID,
       POVRSINA_ZPS,
       regexp_substr(SDO_UTIL.TO_WKTGEOMETRY(GEOM), '^[A-Z]+')                                     as ORIGINAL_TIP_GEOM
